name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A pre-packaged toolkit that teaches an AI coding assistant how to hunt for security bugs, using thousands of real disclosed vulnerability reports as its playbook.
buyer: A freelance bug-bounty hunter or small security consultancy that wants to triage more targets per week without hiring junior analysts.
business_use_cases: A solo bug-bounty hunter runs it against a new HackerOne program overnight to get a first-pass list of likely vulnerable endpoints before spending their own hours on it.
A boutique pentest shop uses it as a junior-analyst substitute on routine web-app engagements, freeing senior staff for the harder findings.
A SaaS company's internal security team runs it against their own codebase before a release to catch common vulnerability classes early.

money_ideas.idea: Offer it as the engine behind a 'first-pass security triage' service sold to startups that can't afford a full pentest.
Package a hosted, supported version with report templates for bug-bounty hunters who don't want to run it themselves.

steal_this: Run it against your own side-project repo this weekend, package the findings into a one-page 'security health check' PDF, and offer that exact check to five indie SaaS founders for $99.
